prompt:
Edit the first reference strip (the OLD ANIMOL Moon Palace T01_A design), preserving its design and all four sprite silhouettes. Restore that specific old design, do not invent an alternative. Produce one horizontal row with the same four separate sprites in order: 1) square masonry material swatch, 2) square solid masonry frame, 3) same frame with a large transparent center hole, 4) cross-shaped architectural joint. Give each sprite comfortable transparent padding. No text, labels, grid, checkerboard or background.

The first strip is the authority for the brick arrangements and END SHAPES. The second strip is ONLY a reminder of how quiet flat shading can be; its blank teal interiors and long heavy straight purple corner posts are precisely the regression to fix. The final two references show the same staircase before and after and explain the issue.

Restore the offset interlocking jade masonry blocks and their clear continuous dark mortar joints. Keep the old rectangle sizes, rounded/chamfered corners, cream cap stones, coral-orange brackets, purple fasteners and old compact cap/foot shapes. The material swatch must visibly contain a real repeating brick structure rather than an undivided color plane. Body joints are purposeful architectural lines, not noise. The frame's interior must have the same jade masonry. Endcaps must keep the previous wide cream cap, small coral return, compact bracket, and old compact stepped bottom foot proportions. Do not make the upper ends into large purple vertical pillars or dangling L-shaped clips. No top-view platform surface: strictly side-on orthographic 2D platformer architecture, horizontal walkable top, minimum visible top plane.

Clean pixel art: large flat color clusters. Each jade block uses a flat teal face and at most one consistent connected highlight strip and one connected shadow strip, always with the same light direction. Retain mortar lines even when removing shading. NO stippling, speckles, dithering, mottling, painted gradient, isolated decorative pixels, distressed cracks, spiral engraving, jaggies or doubled diagonal pixels. Clean one-pixel outlines at the intended native sprite resolution, with regular staircase steps on chamfers. Structural colored beams may be thick but their dark contour should be consistent. Crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing. Do not flatten the architectural outlines or erase the brick separations during cleanup.

Use ONLY this palette for opaque colors: #1a1c2c #5d275d #b13e53 #ef7d57 #ffcd75 #a7f070 #38b764 #257179 #29366f #3b5dc9 #41a6f6 #73eff7 #f4f4f4 #94b0c2 #566c86 #333c57. Preserve the old palette relationships; teal jade, cream walkable cap, coral bracket, purple fastener. Transparent background and hole. The material itself is a square filled face; no enclosing decorative frame. Keep all four sprites the same apparent size and aligned on one row.
intent: Restore v1 brick joints and old compact endcap proportions while keeping clean flat colors; other 19 styles preserve clean_v2 pixels.
